fields.Name: ORD-34 - Party Roster
fields.Description: Orders' contribution to the shared Party Signals category. CR1-CR2 prove the Party Customer Roster query is discoverable by the shared party pickers and that the rows it returns honour the four-column contract, so a picker can offer customers before the rest of the directory instead of searching the whole organization file.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: The Party Customer Roster query is registered in the Party Signals category and its description carries the [signal: order|orders] marker; the query runs successfully, and every row has PartyKind of organization or person, a non-empty PartyID, and a Count of at least one.
